title: malvastrum grossulariifolium
intro: Malvastrum grossulariifolium, commonly known as the "Red Currant-Leaf Mallow", is a plant species in the Malvaceae family, known for its edible leaves and medicinal properties. The Red Currant-Leaf Mallow is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may help alleviate conditions such as digestive issues, wounds, and skin problems. Its therapeutic actions include soothing and protecting the mucous membranes, as well as exhibiting antiseptic and astringent properties. The bioactive constituents of Malvastrum grossulariifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
